CUPLIKAN NASKAH PEMBUKA: "TUT T LE Publishing Tokyo Rutland, Vermont Singapore Japanese Knitting & Crochet Stitches THE ULTIMATE BIBLE FOR NEEDLECRAFT ENTHUSIASTS Knitting can be a mysterious activity. The same knitted shape can take on many forms, depending on the choice of color, pattern and materials. This collection of 1000 knitting and crochet stitches shows the stitches as symbols, placed in a gridded chart. For knitted stitches, each box of the grid is a stitch. Next to the chart is a photo of each stitch, so it’s easy to see how the chart relates to the completed stitch. Use the stitches in this book to create original knitted and crocheted garments, and when you want to try various arrangements of the fabrics.
